dalia: Quick sync for the Pegasus case study. Need interview, hero + supporting quote, legal OK on numbers, gated benchmark PDF, and a webinar the week after publish. Target publish Thurs. Can we close by Tue EOD?

omar: I can run the interview Mon 11am PT. Will focus on the rollout story and perf wins.

sophie: I'll draft two quote options and a 30-40 word blurb for the webinar page.

ben: Ops exported sanitized perf CSV: /mnt/benchmarks/pegasus/pegasus-redacted-2026.csv. I'll make a short appendix with commands.

legal-bot: Reminder: no contract figures or raw user counts. Replace absolute numbers with "large-scale production" unless Pegasus confirms. Upload NDA/consent to drive link.

omar: Example sanitized command for appendix:
./run_bench --model open-7b --seq 1024 --batch 8 --samples 1000 > results.json
(we'll strip internal flags)

sophie: Draft hero: "Redwood made production inference reliable enough for real-time features." Long: "After moving to Redwood routing and prefix caching we saw big wins in p99 and median latency that let us launch low-latency features."

dalia: Good. Sophie please tag hero/long in the doc and flag the hero quote for live approval during the call. Ben, confirm gated PDF path and I'll add to the blog once legal clears.

ben: Gated PDF ready pending legal review. publish-bot: tentative slot 2026-04-15 09:00 PT.

legal-bot: I'll review quotes + appendix after interview transcript and CSV uploaded. Expect sign-off within 48 hours.

dalia: Thanks team. Checkpoint Tue EOD for legal clearance. If green, publish-bot will flip the post. :thumbsup:

end of thread
